items.uz: Mening fikrimcha, bu qaror to'g'ri emas.
items.en: In my opinion, this decision is not correct.

items.uz: Sizning fikringizni tushunaman, ammo rozi emasman.
items.en: I understand your opinion, but I disagree.

items.uz: Bu masalaga boshqa tomondan qarash kerak.
items.en: This issue needs to be looked at from another angle.
In my opinion, this solution is the most suitable.

items.uz: Har ikkalamiz ham haq bo'lishimiz mumkin.
items.en: We can both be right.

I hope we will reach an agreement.

items.en: How did this play affect you?
